Send crash and ANR reports with safe context. On by default.
Crash reports help identify device-specific failures without asking you to reproduce the issue with ADB logs.
Future crashes and current ANRs from this device will not be reported. This can make device-specific bugs much harder to fix.
Reports are grouped by app version, device model, Android version, and stack trace so the most common real crashes can be fixed first.

Nuvio uses the TMDB API for movie and TV metadata, artwork, trailers, cast, production details, collections, and recommendations. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Nuvio uses IMDb Non-Commercial Datasets, including title.ratings.tsv.gz, for IMDb ratings and vote counts. Information courtesy of IMDb (https://www.imdb.com). Used with permission. IMDb data is for personal and non-commercial use under IMDb's terms.
Nuvio connects to Trakt for account authentication, watched history, progress sync, library data, ratings, lists, and comments. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by Trakt.

Nuvio connects to Simkl for account authentication, watchlists, watched history, playback progress, and scrobbling. Movie, TV, and anime tracking data is provided by Simkl. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by Simkl.
Nuvio connects to Premiumize for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by Premiumize.
Nuvio connects to TorBox for account authentication, cloud library access, cache checks, and cloud playback features. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by TorBox.
Nuvio uses MDBList for ratings and external score provider data. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by MDBList.
Nuvio uses the IntroDB API for community-provided intro, recap, credits, and preview timestamps used by skip controls. Nuvio is not affiliated with or endorsed by IntroDB.
Used for playback on iOS builds.

Nuvio automatically checks Simkl at most once every %1$d minutes. Changes made through another app or the Simkl website may take that long to appear.
Each refresh first checks whether Simkl reports any changes and downloads only the updates. This follows Simkl’s API rules, reduces unnecessary data use, and helps keep the service stable.
